text.id:auto:site-swimming-hole.html:section:: And yet, the moment the gate closes, it feels a world away: completely secluded, regularly mown, and right beside your own private swimming hole. The only interruptions are curious cattle wandering down for a look, and the occasional wallaby at dusk.
Our most accessible site— flat, grassy, deeply shaded by the creek, with a fire pit waiting.
Campfires are welcome and Firewood is available to order, ready and waiting at your campsite when you arrive.   Total fire bans are observed.
